'''2010 Malastare Regionals Stephen Morgan DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Morgan]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Blow Up The Planets or Drain, Drain, Drain
* '''Username:''' Stephen1185
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
